purpose: mahāuttama dharmma thukā (religious merit for whoever commissioned, wrote, or recited the book)
notes: No specific individuals or dates are named; the colophon contains only a generic Newari exhortation/blessing on the merit gained by whoever caused the book to be made, wrote it, or recited it (guhmasyana dayakala gvahmasyana coyāva bila thvahmasyana pātha yāta...).
